sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的 DealBook 峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上免费直播部分精选采访，供所有人观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Today, why Donald Trump's decision to launch missiles into Syria is at odds with nearly everything Donald Trump has said about Syria.
sentences.zh: 今天，为什么唐纳德·特朗普决定向叙利亚发射导弹，与他此前关于叙利亚的一切言论相矛盾。

sentences.en: It's Monday, April 10th.
sentences.zh: 今天是4月10日，星期一。

sentences.en: So, Peter, as a private citizen and a candidate, what did Donald Trump say about America's role in Syria?
sentences.zh: 那么，彼得，作为一名普通公民和候选人，唐纳德·特朗普对美国在叙利亚的角色是怎么说的？

sentences.en: He said, it's not our business.
sentences.zh: 他说，那不关我们的事。

sentences.en: It's not our problem.
sentences.zh: 那不是我们的问题。

sentences.en: He's tweeted that out.
sentences.zh: 他曾在推特上这样写道。

sentences.en: Syria is not our problem with a capital N-O-T.
sentences.zh: 叙利亚不是我们的问题，重点强调“不是”。

sentences.en: Peter Baker is our chief White House correspondent.
sentences.zh: 彼得·贝克是我们白宫首席记者。

sentences.en: And he took a position when President Obama was confronted with, last week, actually much worse than the one last week, in 2013.
sentences.zh: 当奥巴马总统上周面临这种情况时，他采取了立场，实际上比上周的情况还要糟糕，那是在2013年。

sentences.en: And Donald Trump, then private citizen.
sentences.zh: 而当时的唐纳德·特朗普还是一名普通公民。

sentences.en: Will you stay out of Syria?
sentences.zh: 你会远离叙利亚吗？

sentences.en: I would have stayed out of Syria, and I wouldn't have fought so much for Assad, against Assad, because I thought that was a whole thing.
sentences.zh: 我会远离叙利亚，我不会为了阿萨德或者反对阿萨德而进行那么多抗争，因为我觉得那整件事都很复杂。

sentences.en: So he was very explicit.
sentences.zh: 所以他表达得非常明确。

sentences.en: Very explicit.
sentences.zh: 非常明确。

sentences.en: Very straightforward.
sentences.zh: 非常直截了当。

sentences.en: Multiple tweets, not just one time.
sentences.zh: 发了多条推文，不止一次。

sentences.en: And he felt that it was not our business to get involved.
sentences.zh: 他认为介入此事不关我们的事。

sentences.en: You say you wouldn't go into Syria, you wouldn't have fought Assad.
sentences.zh: 你说你不会进入叙利亚，你不会去对抗阿萨德。

sentences.en: But I would go after ISIS.
sentences.zh: 但我会去对付“伊斯兰国”。

sentences.en: A big league.
sentences.zh: 大联盟级别的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And what did Donald Trump say, again, as citizen and candidate...
sentences.zh: 那么唐纳德·特朗普作为公民和候选人，又是怎么说的……

sentences.en: Donald, good morning.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德，早上好。

sentences.en: Good morning.
sentences.zh: 早上好。

sentences.en: How's it going?
sentences.zh: 最近怎么样？

sentences.en: It's going well.
sentences.zh: 一切顺利。

sentences.en: Yeah?
sentences.zh: 是吗？

sentences.en: ...about America's relationship to Russia and what he wanted it to be.
sentences.zh: ……关于美国与俄罗斯的关系，以及他希望这种关系是什么样的。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: He thought we ought to be friends.
sentences.zh: 他认为我们应该成为朋友。

sentences.en: Do you like Vladimir Putin's comments about you?
sentences.zh: 你喜欢弗拉基米尔·普京对你的评价吗？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: When people call you brilliant, it's always good, especially when the person heads up Russia.
sentences.zh: 当人们称赞你才华横溢时，总是件好事，尤其是当对方是俄罗斯领导人时。

sentences.en: He should get along, because a lot of presidents have said that.
sentences.zh: 他应该相处得来，因为很多总统都这么说过。

sentences.en: But he really was pretty, when it came to things like the intervention in Ukraine, when it came to things like Crimea, when it came to things like intervention in Syria.
sentences.zh: 但在涉及乌克兰干预、克里米亚问题以及叙利亚干预等事情上，他确实表现得相当……

sentences.en: He basically said, well, we welcome that, because we're going to be partners with them in Syria against ISIS.
sentences.zh: 他基本上说，好吧，我们对此表示欢迎，因为我们将与他们在叙利亚合作对抗“伊斯兰国”。

sentences.en: Russia wants to get rid of ISIS.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯想消灭“伊斯兰国”。

sentences.en: We want to get rid of ISIS.
sentences.zh: 我们也想消灭“伊斯兰国”。

sentences.en: Maybe let Russia do it.
sentences.zh: 也许让俄罗斯去做吧。

sentences.en: Let them get rid of ISIS.
sentences.zh: 让他们去消灭“伊斯兰国”。

sentences.en: What the hell do we care?
sentences.zh: 我们管那么多干嘛？

sentences.en: So, he took a very friendly approach toward Vladimir Putin and the Kremlin as a candidate.
sentences.zh: 所以，作为候选人，他对弗拉基米尔·普京和克里姆林宫采取了非常友好的态度。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, late last week, as you well know, President Trump sent 59 Tomahawk missiles into Syria,
sentences.zh: 那么，正如你所知，上周晚些时候，特朗普总统向叙利亚发射了59枚战斧导弹，

sentences.en: where Russia has troops on the ground and is formally an ally of the Syrian government of Assad.
sentences.zh: 而俄罗斯在那里有地面部队，并且在形式上是阿萨德叙利亚政府的盟友。

sentences.en: What did we learn about these two things we just talked about from that action?
sentences.zh: 从这一行动中，我们对刚才讨论的那两件事了解到了什么？

sentences.en: We went against everything Donald Trump as a candidate had said.
sentences.zh: 我们违背了唐纳德·特朗普作为候选人所说的一切。

sentences.en: He said we should not be intervening in the middle of Syria's civil war beyond fighting ISIS, and we shouldn't be alienating Russia.
sentences.zh: 他说除了打击“伊斯兰国”之外，我们不应该干预叙利亚内战，也不应该疏远俄罗斯。

sentences.en: Obama never did.
sentences.zh: 奥巴马从未这样做过。

sentences.en: We will pursue this diplomatic track.
sentences.zh: 我们将继续推进这一外交途径。

sentences.en: I fervently hope that this can be resolved in a non-military way.
sentences.zh: 我热切希望这能以非军事方式解决。

sentences.en: President Obama never authorized direct action against Bashar al-Assad, Russian troops, Russian airmen, and a little notice.
sentences.zh: 奥巴马总统从未授权对巴沙尔·阿萨德、俄罗斯军队、俄罗斯飞行员采取直接行动，而且几乎没有预警。

sentences.en: It's kind of a close thing when you're hitting the very same base.
sentences.zh: 当你打击同一个基地时，这确实有点危险。

sentences.en: Peter, can that actually be, in its own way, a powerful strategy?
sentences.zh: 彼得，这本身能成为一种强大的策略吗？

sentences.en: Case-by-case decisions that might look like inconsistency or a lack of a strategy?
sentences.zh: 那些看起来像是前后矛盾或缺乏策略的个案决策？

sentences.en: And would you define it as strategic, or is it just kind of happenstance?
sentences.zh: 你会将其定义为战略，还是仅仅是偶然？

sentences.en: It does have a potential advantage, right?
sentences.zh: 它确实有一个潜在的优势，对吧？

sentences.en: Which is, if you don't really know what the other guy's going to do, it leaves you guessing and wondering, and perhaps North Korea takes away from this.
sentences.zh: 那就是，如果你真的不知道对方要做什么，这会让你猜测和怀疑，也许朝鲜会从中吸取教训。

sentences.en: And you remember Richard Nixon had what he called the madman strategy.
sentences.zh: 你还记得理查德·尼克松有所谓的“疯子策略”吗？

sentences.en: What he actually did call it a strategy, and he was very calculated about it.
sentences.zh: 他确实称之为策略，而且他对此经过了深思熟虑。

sentences.en: But he told Kissinger a lot of the times, look, you tell them you've got this crazy president.
sentences.zh: 但他多次告诉基辛格，看，你要告诉他们你有一个疯狂的总统。

sentences.en: You can't predict what he's going to do.
sentences.zh: 你无法预测他会做什么。

sentences.en: He might do anything.
sentences.zh: 他什么事都做得出来。

sentences.en: And he thought that was a great, trying to convince other actors on the international stage to do what he wanted, because who knows what he might do otherwise.
sentences.zh: 他认为这很棒，试图说服国际舞台上的其他参与者按他的意愿行事，因为谁知道他如果不按常理出牌会做什么。

sentences.en: But just to be clear, in the case of President Trump versus, for example, President Nixon, you believe this is more instinctive than grand strategy?
sentences.zh: 但为了明确起见，以特朗普总统与尼克松总统为例，你认为这更多是本能反应而非宏大战略？

sentences.en: I think so.
sentences.zh: 我想是的。

sentences.en: That's certainly what it looks like now.
sentences.zh: 目前看起来确实如此。

sentences.en: You know, we're only 75 days or so into his administration.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他的政府才上任75天左右。

sentences.en: So far, it looks like a man who's responding according to what his gut tells him to do.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，他看起来像是一个根据直觉行事的人。

sentences.en: Yesterday, chemical attack.
sentences.zh: 昨天，化学武器袭击。

sentences.en: In this case, in the Syria case, against innocent people, including women, small children, and even beautiful little babies.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，在叙利亚事件中，针对无辜平民，包括妇女、小孩，甚至美丽的婴儿。

sentences.en: Their deaths was an affront to humanity.
sentences.zh: 他们的死亡是对人类的侮辱。

sentences.en: Infected by the small children's responsibility.
sentences.zh: 受到小孩责任的影响。

sentences.en: And in some way, years ago, As Rex Tillerson, the Secretary of State, heads to Russia this week,
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，几年前，随着国务卿雷克斯·蒂勒森本周前往俄罗斯，

sentences.en: Can we count on the United States wanting to keep that relationship, the United States and Russia, as strong as possible?
sentences.zh: 我们能指望美国希望尽可能保持美俄关系的稳固吗？

sentences.en: I don't think that we've necessarily thrown aside the idea that we can work with Russia at this point.
sentences.zh: 我不认为我们目前已经完全放弃了与俄罗斯合作的想法。

sentences.en: But...
sentences.zh: 但是……

sentences.en: Well, I think the Russians have played now for some time the role of providing cover for Bashar al-Assad's behavior.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为俄罗斯人长期以来一直扮演着为巴沙尔·阿萨德的行为提供掩护的角色。

sentences.en: You heard Rex Tillerson in his Sunday show interviews, for instance, take a pretty tough line on Russia.
sentences.zh: 例如，你听到了雷克斯·蒂勒森在周日节目采访中对俄罗斯采取了相当强硬的立场。

sentences.en: Regardless of whether Russia was complicit here, or whether they were simply incompetent, or whether they got outwitted by the Bashar al-Assad regime,
sentences.zh: 无论俄罗斯是否在此事中同谋，或者他们只是无能，又或者他们被巴沙尔·阿萨德政权愚弄了，

sentences.en: you would have to ask the Russians that question.
sentences.zh: 你得去问俄罗斯人这个问题。

sentences.en: But clearly, they have failed in their commitment to the international community.
sentences.zh: 但显然，他们未能履行对国际社会的承诺。

sentences.en: He's saying, look, they were...
sentences.zh: 他在说，看，他们当时……

sentences.en: In terms of monitoring Syria's possession of these chemical weapons that they had, in theory, gotten rid of under Russian auspices.
sentences.zh: 在监督叙利亚拥有这些化学武器方面，理论上，在俄罗斯的主持下，他们本应销毁这些武器。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He's laying the blame on Moscow for the fact that this chemical weapon attack happened.
sentences.zh: 他将这次化学武器袭击的责任归咎于莫斯科。

sentences.en: That's tough stuff, and we'll see what happens.
sentences.zh: 这很强硬，我们拭目以待。

sentences.en: On the other side, Dmitry Medvedev, the prime minister of Russia, said on Facebook after the strike, he described the relationship as, quote, completely ruined.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，俄罗斯总理德米特里·梅德韦杰夫在袭击后在 Facebook 上表示，他将这种关系描述为“彻底破裂”。

sentences.en: And he said that basically now the fog is lifted, and all the campaign talk, in effect, he's saying, turns out to be just that.
sentences.zh: 他说，基本上现在迷雾散去，所有的竞选言论，实际上他是在说，结果证明仅仅是言论而已。

sentences.en: So there's a kind of an interesting atmosphere that Rex Tillerson is going to be walking into.
sentences.zh: 所以雷克斯·蒂勒森即将进入的氛围相当有趣。

sentences.en: And in fact, you know, there's some talk about whether he actually will get in to see Putin in the end, because there is sort of this mystical man, too.
sentences.zh: 事实上，你知道，关于他最终是否能见到普京还有些讨论，因为那里也有某种神秘的人。

sentences.en: And I don't think he's interested in necessarily blowing up the relationship, if there's common ground.
sentences.zh: 我不认为他有兴趣在有共同点的情况下破坏这种关系。

sentences.en: And I think, you know, you're going to see both sides probably try to find a way to move past this if they can.
sentences.zh: 我认为，你知道，如果可能的话，你会看到双方都试图找到一种方法来超越这一点。

sentences.en: So this trip that the Secretary of State is taking, it was planned before the missile attack.
sentences.zh: 所以国务卿这次的行程是在导弹袭击之前就计划好的。

sentences.en: The trip, the whole...
sentences.zh: 这次行程，整个……

sentences.en: Peter, a separate question, because you are reporting 24 hours a day at this point.
sentences.zh: 彼得，问个别的问题，因为你现在是24小时全天候报道。

sentences.en: You're also digging into the events of the past week and what they mean for the legacy of President Obama,
sentences.zh: 你也在深入挖掘过去一周发生的事件，以及它们对奥巴马总统的遗产意味着什么，

sentences.en: who, as you said, did not take action against Syria after that 2013 chemical attack.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，他在2013年那次化学武器袭击后没有对叙利亚采取行动。

sentences.en: Can you tell us what you're hearing about how this is challenging Obama's legacy?
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我们你听到的关于这如何挑战奥巴马遗产的看法吗？

sentences.en: Well, of course, President Obama had what he thought was a pretty compelling answer when people said, hey, you said a red line, but then didn't enforce it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当然，当人们说，嘿，你划定了红线，但后来没有执行时，奥巴马总统认为他有一个相当令人信服的答案。

sentences.en: Our interest is in helping the Syrian people.
sentences.zh: 我们的利益在于帮助叙利亚人民。

sentences.en: But nobody suggests that us being involved in a land war in Syria would necessarily accomplish this goal.
sentences.zh: 但没有人建议我们卷入叙利亚的地面战争就能实现这一目标。

sentences.en: And I would note that those who criticize our foreign policy with respect to Syria, they themselves say, no, no, no, we don't mean sending in troops.
sentences.zh: 而且我要指出，那些批评我们在叙利亚外交政策的人，他们自己也说，不，不，不，我们不是指派兵。

sentences.en: Well, what do you mean?
sentences.zh: 那么，你指的是什么？

sentences.en: And his answer was, look, yes, that's fine, but I got a better deal.
sentences.zh: 他的回答是，看，是的，那很好，但我达成了一个更好的协议。

sentences.en: I had an agreement with Vladimir Putin and Bashar al-Assad to remove all of his chemical weapons.
sentences.zh: 我和弗拉基米尔·普京以及巴沙尔·阿萨德达成了一项协议，销毁他所有的化学武器。

sentences.en: And isn't that better than just sort of a pointless military strike anyway?
sentences.zh: 这难道不比那种毫无意义的军事打击更好吗？

sentences.en: Well, perhaps you should have taken a strike in Syria to get chemical weapons out of Syria.
sentences.zh: 嗯，也许你应该在叙利亚进行一次打击，以清除叙利亚的化学武器。

sentences.en: Well, it turns out we're getting chemical weapons out of Syria without having initiated a strike.
sentences.zh: 嗯，事实证明，我们在没有发动打击的情况下正在清除叙利亚的化学武器。

sentences.en: So what else are you talking about?
sentences.zh: 那你还在谈论什么？

sentences.en: And at that point, it kind of trails off.
sentences.zh: 在那一点上，话题就有点淡化了。

sentences.en: And for a few years, the problem is we now see that Bashar al-Assad either cheated, he said he did,
sentences.zh: 几年来，问题在于我们现在看到巴沙尔·阿萨德要么欺骗了，他说他做了，

sentences.en: or he somehow did very publicly how they think actually, in fact, Donald Trump actually did the right thing
sentences.zh: 或者他以某种方式非常公开地做了，他们认为实际上，唐纳德·特朗普确实做了正确的事，

sentences.en: and how they wish that their administration had done for and maybe this deal wasn't.
sentences.zh: 他们希望他们的政府也这样做，也许这个协议并不是……

sentences.en: It's interesting, Peter.
sentences.zh: 很有趣，彼得。

sentences.en: I mean, will President Trump's attack on Syria be seen as recognition that you can't trust a dictator
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，特朗普总统对叙利亚的袭击会被视为一种认识，即你不能信任独裁者，

sentences.en: in a way that President Obama was perhaps a little naive in thinking that he could?
sentences.zh: 而奥巴马总统在认为他可以信任时，也许有点天真？

sentences.en: Well, certainly President Obama came to office promising to deal with the world's rogue leaders.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当然，奥巴马总统上任时承诺要处理世界上的流氓领导人。

sentences.en: He said he would meet, in fact, in person with some of the worst actors on the stage,
sentences.zh: 他说他实际上会亲自会见舞台上一些最糟糕的参与者，

sentences.en: including, he didn't actually do that with motion, but he did cut a deal with Iran on their nuclear chemical weapons.
sentences.zh: 包括，他实际上没有和那个人这样做，但他确实与伊朗就核化学武器达成了协议。

sentences.en: And his view is diplomat.
sentences.zh: 他的观点是外交。

sentences.en: We can see the limits of diplomat who's not honorable and not willing to live up to the agreement they made.
sentences.zh: 我们可以看到一个不光荣且不愿履行协议的谈判者的局限性。

sentences.en: So I think that's certainly going to be a lesson.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这肯定会是一个教训。

sentences.en: I think it's going to be a lesson that President Trump takes, as he proceeds, about, you know...
sentences.zh: 我认为这将是特朗普总统在前进过程中吸取的教训，关于，你知道……

sentences.en: Peter, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 彼得，非常感谢。

sentences.en: I'm going to let you tend to that dog, as we often tell the listeners of The Daily.
sentences.zh: 我要让你去照顾那只狗了，正如我们经常告诉《每日新闻》听众的那样。

sentences.en: This is the news, but it's also real life.
sentences.zh: 这是新闻，但这也是真实生活。

sentences.en: Hey, have a good one.
sentences.zh: 嘿，祝你过得愉快。

sentences.en: Take care.
sentences.zh: 保重。

sentences.en: Thanks.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: Bye-bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·罗森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重塑者》，这是一个关于设计之爱及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you, and you turned a DJ booth into this, like,
sentences.zh: 即使在我还在黑胶唱片时代在夜店当 DJ 的时候，你每天晚上都要带着300件最珍贵的收藏品去工作，你把 DJ 台变成了一个，就像是，

sentences.en: living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 充满活力的、展示50年历史精美文物的快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你喜爱的播客平台上收听爱彼的《重构者》节目。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《纽约时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能让你免费试用一个月，且无需绑定信用卡，去探索《纽约时报》呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以做到了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序，即可免费使用第一个月。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《纽约时报》订阅用户每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载这款应用，获取30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Here is what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: The Islamic State is claiming credit for two suicide bombings at Christian churches in Egypt on Sunday, Palm Sunday, that killed at least 44 people and injured dozens more.
sentences.zh: 伊斯兰国声称对周日（棕枝主日）发生在埃及两座基督教堂的自杀式炸弹袭击负责，袭击造成至少44人死亡，数十人受伤。

sentences.en: The attacks are a challenge to Egypt's strongman leader, President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi, who returned from a visit to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这些袭击是对埃及强人领袖、总统阿卜杜勒-法塔赫·塞西的挑战，他刚从美国访问归来。

sentences.en: on Friday.
sentences.zh: 就在周五。

sentences.en: I just want to let everybody know, in case there was any doubt, that we are very much behind President el-Sisi.
sentences.zh: 我只是想让大家知道，如果还有任何疑问的话，我们非常支持塞西总统。

sentences.en: Where President Trump hailed him in the fight against ISIS.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统在打击伊斯兰国的斗争中对他大加赞赏。

sentences.en: I just want to say to you, Mr. President, that you have a great friend and ally in the United States and in me.
sentences.zh: 总统先生，我只想对你说，在美国，在我这里，你有一位伟大的朋友和盟友。

sentences.en: Trump made clear he could overlook Sisi's record of mass detentions, torture and killings,
sentences.zh: 特朗普明确表示，他可以忽略塞西在大规模拘留、酷刑和杀戮方面的记录，

sentences.en: in favor of combating ISIS and defending minority Christians in Egypt, whom ISIS has signaled it would target.
sentences.zh: 转而支持打击伊斯兰国并保护埃及的少数派基督徒，因为伊斯兰国已表示会将他们作为目标。

sentences.en: And...
sentences.zh: 还有……

sentences.en: Is there any senator who wishes to change his or her vote?
sentences.zh: 有哪位参议员希望更改投票吗？

sentences.en: President Trump's Supreme Court nominee, Neil Gorsuch, is scheduled to be sworn in as an associate justice today, the court's 101St.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统提名的最高法院大法官人选尼尔·戈萨奇定于今天宣誓就职，成为该院第101位大法官。

sentences.en: Gorsuch was confirmed by a vote of 54 to 45 on Friday, with the support of just three Democrats.
sentences.zh: 戈萨奇于周五以54票对45票获得确认，仅得到了三名民主党人的支持。

sentences.en: The nomination of Neil M.
sentences.zh: 尼尔·M·戈萨奇被提名为美国最高法院大法官，

sentences.en: Gorsuch of Colorado to be an associate justice of the Supreme Court of the United States is confirmed.
sentences.zh: 现已获得确认。

sentences.en: Finally, the Times reports that President Trump has warned two warring factions inside his White House to make peace.
sentences.zh: 最后，《纽约时报》报道称，特朗普总统已警告白宫内部的两个交战派系要讲和。

sentences.en: Fed up with infighting between Steve Bannon and Jared Kushner, Trump told them to, quote, work this out.
sentences.zh: 由于厌倦了史蒂夫·班农和贾里德·库什纳之间的内斗，特朗普告诉他们，引用原话，“把这个问题解决掉”。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine, until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台严密控制的机器一样运作，直到今年夏天，选举迎来了一批自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场激烈、混乱，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《地铁》节目中，我和莎拉·凯尼格将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中逐渐失控的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》节目。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 在你获取播客的任何地方收听。
